candidate.answerReason: The unit cubes have 6n^3 faces altogether, of which 6n^2 are red. Their red-face fraction is 1/n, so n=4.

methods.label: Compare painted faces with all faces
methods.explanation:
Count the faces of the individual unit cubes, including the newly exposed faces made by cutting. There are \(n^3\) unit cubes with six faces each, so the total is \(6n^3\) faces.

Only faces on the outside of the original cube are painted. Each original face contains \(n^2\) unit faces, and each painted unit face belongs to exactly one of the six original faces. Thus there are \(6n^2\) red faces.

Since \(n\) is a positive integer, the red-face fraction simplifies to
\[\frac{6n^2}{6n^3}=\frac1n.\]
The given fraction is \(\frac14\), so \(n=4\), choice \(\mathrm{B}\).
